issue: Tier 1 title in an older laryngeal-less, accentless notation (owis eḱwoi kʷe); accepted as a published variant.
Tier 1 fable line; Héǵrom (H for h₂) is a notation variant of h₂éǵrom.
péh₂urih₁ is NOM/ACC.DU of péh₂wr̥ ('two fires'); English 'The fire cooks' needs NOM.SG péh₂wr̥. Number error.
h₂roh₁dʰéyet 'spoke': causative of h₂reh₁dʰ- whose 'speak' sense is Germanic only (Goth. rodjan); stretched sense.
Gnomic aorists Hwérdʰt/stéwdt for English presents acceptable; néḱeti 'is dying' ~ 'has gone out'.
h₂éḱesi is LOC.SG of h₂éḱos; 'cut off the ears' needs the object ACC.PL h₂éḱesh₂ (as elsewhere in the batch). Case error.
bʰéwdʰt is AOR.3SG ('woke') for English 'at dawn it wakes' (present/subjunctive expected); ph₂wéns 'of the fire' rendered 'about the fire'.
ḱóymoy LOC.SG thematic -oy acceptable; ń̥werǵos privative bahuvrihi.
légʰeti-kʷe is indicative 'and he lies' where English has 'let him lie down'.
widétām is AOR.3DU; subject h₁wesuḱléwēs is singular ('he saw the field'): needs widét. Number error.
h₂roh₁dʰéyet 'spoke' stretched sense (Germanic-only meaning of a causative).
h₁íns masc for cows follows lexicon gender of gʷṓws (m).
tóybʰos (plural) for a two-animal team otherwise treated as dual (tóh₁, h₁ludʰḗtes, duktés); h₂roh₁dʰéye 'speak' stretched.
wérǵōy is DAT.SG of wérǵom; 'did the work' needs ACC.SG wérǵom as object of wérǵt. Case error.
